items.html: *Now, after he restricted himself, he placed one Parsa in the middle of his Guf, at the place of his Tabur, on the inside, so that it would separate between them. And this is the secret of “Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters,” as mentioned in the Zohar, Beresheet, page 32: “There is one membrane in the middle of a man’s innards, which separates from above to below, and draws from above and gives to below.” And then all the light remained above that Parsa, and it was pressed and compressed there. And then it breaks through that Parsa and descends and shines into the rest of the Guf, from the Tabur downward.
